bluf: Tuesday Nov 3 is the planning problem; today is quiet. WashU hosts public polling 6 AM-7 PM at the Athletic Complex (County) and McDonnell Medical Sciences, 4565 McKinley (City), with Amendment 3 on the ballot. A cold front brings all-day rain Tuesday with possible 40-50 mph afternoon gusts (mainly east of the Mississippi); no severe storms expected and no NWS products in effect. No threat naming WashU and no violent incident on a WashU asset in 72 h. MetroLink Blue Line now ends at Forest Park-DeBaliviere. Posture Elevated for the Tue-Wed election window.
